tagline: A city in a forest, where civil-rights history, Olympic parkland and a rail-trail loop stitch together the South's busiest downtown.

events.name: Atlanta Dogwood Festival
events.desc: A long-running arts fair and spring festival under the blossoming trees of Piedmont Park.

events.name: Atlanta Jazz Festival
events.desc: A free, city-run jazz festival in Piedmont Park over Memorial Day weekend.

events.name: Peachtree Road Race
events.desc: One of the world's largest 10K races, run down Peachtree from Buckhead to Midtown on Independence Day.

events.name: Dragon Con
events.desc: A vast fan convention that takes over the downtown hotels, with a costumed parade along Peachtree Street.
